title: Garden Environment Music (GEM)
description:
Garden Environment is a mod who add sounds playable for a ModPack !

/playsound gardenenvironment:[sound]
body:
**An immersive audio journey for your Minecraft world!**

This complementary mod enhances your Minecraft experience by adding beautiful and atmospheric music from two captivating works: FAR: Lone Sails and Vampire in the Garden.

**✨ Main Features:**

Hauntingly emotional tracks from FAR: Lone Sails to accompany your lonely travels and peaceful builds.
 
Enchanting and mysterious melodies from Vampire in the Garden, perfect for serene moments or story-rich gameplay.

Seamlessly integrates into your existing modpack as an audio enhancement module.

🎮 Ideal for players looking to add a narrative, emotional, and immersive layer to their Minecraft adventures—whether solo or multiplayer.

(requires to play sounds with the /playsound command because its a complementary mod for my future ModPack ! ^^) : /playsound gardenenvironment:[sound] {do [tab] to see everything !}
